items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: "Joe Hopkins, he played nice piano. Hopkins, I don't even know that."

ctx.x: The keys, the keys look good. I mean, they really work good. It's in a good, perfect shape. Yeah, it's in a good shape. Yeah. Did you hear any other old time pianists, say, along that period, like Bruce or any of the others that you can think of, that maybe we haven't heard of, that you ran across in some of those parties, that maybe when you'd be playing they'd come in and sit in or anything. Do you remember any of the earlier ones when you were just a kid, even? Well, I had a few. Some I forgot, and a few of…
Some of them I really forgot their names. But I remember during the time when I was coming up to this bar, Joe Hopkins, he played nice piano. Hopkins, I don't even know that.
